rows.en:
At last I could calmly do my business.
…………
Phew, that feels better.
…………
Wow, I must have been really holding it in. There's still more coming.
…………
Huh?
I felt eyes on me, as if someone were watching me from somewhere.
That's strange. Had the seniors come back?{p}
I started to walk out of the restroom.

"Hey, wait a second."
I heard a voice calling me back.
That's strange.
There shouldn't be anyone in this restroom except me...
I turned around to look behind me.{p}

"☆"
Someone was peering in through the gap in the window!
Hey, hey, you've got to be kidding me.
This is the third floor★{p}

I panicked and tried to dash out of the restroom.
I couldn't get out☆
It wasn't that the restroom door was shut.
The door was standing wide open, yet whenever I tried to leave the restroom, my body wouldn't move forward.
Desperate, I threw myself at the doorway as if I were trying to ram my way through.
Even so, I couldn't get out.
I felt sweat bursting out all over my body.
I turned around to look behind me.{p}

"Whoa!"
Incredibly, the person who had been peering in was now standing inside the restroom.
I frantically tried to rush outside.
But no matter what I did, I couldn't get out.
I turned around once more.
It had come closer than before.
"S-stay awaaay☆"
I screamed with all my might.
Then that thing came charging straight at me at tremendous speed.{p}

It passed right through me.
I spun around in a panic to look behind me.{p}

But there was no longer anyone there.
...Hah... hah... hah... hah-hah-hah-hah.
What was that just now?
I wiped away the sweat streaming down my forehead.
"Hee hee hee."
"Giggle giggle."
"Heh heh heh heh heh."{p}

Now laughter was coming from all over the restroom!
It felt as if the voices were spinning around and around inside my head.
"Stop iiit!"
Screaming, I tried to bolt out of the restroom.{p}
...No one there.{p}

"Oh, sorry, sorry.
It's nothing. Nothing at all."
Hosoda said it with a look as if he had caught himself.
Then he turned his face away so he wouldn't have to look at me.
...Could Hosoda see someone standing behind me?
I turned around one more time.{p}
Again, no one there.{p}

Hosoda kept stealing glances at me, then turning his face away.
Then, looking at everyone except me, he said,
"W-well, everyone, now that {a} is back, let's move on to the next story."
Hosoda looked as if he was frightened of something.
…………{p}

I no longer knew what to do.
The urge to try opening the door and the feeling that I had to run from here this instant were fighting inside me.
At the very least, I had a duty as a member of the newspaper club.
...To make this feature a success.
When I thought of that, a growing conviction welled up in me that I had to stay here and see this situation through to the end.
I hadn't heard that sound again since then.
All I could hear was the sound of water dripping from the faucet...
"I have to open it after all and check what's inside..."
I reached out my hand and took hold of the knob.{p}

"Gyaaaaaah!"
I screamed as loud as I could.

Heedless of my scream, the banging from inside the stall kept on just as before.
At this rate, I felt like I was going to lose my mind.
"That's it, I just have to get out of here."
How could I have forgotten something so simple?{p}

"Bam, bam☆"
Without thinking, I pounded back on the door.
Then the knocking from inside the door stopped dead.
Relieved, I sank to my knees right there.
"Whoa☆"{p}

I took a deep breath.
Then I happened to glance at the window.
"Maybe the window will open."
So I went over to the window.{p}

Just then, an upside-down human silhouette appeared on the frosted glass.
"Eek!"
I leapt back without thinking.
Frosted glass or not, the shadow was showing its expressions.
It laughed, raged, grieved, cycling through expressions like that, and then the shadow vanished.{p}

"What on earth is going on..."
A greasy sweat ran down my face and dripped off.
I went up to the window again and timidly tried opening it.
Unexpectedly, the window slid open smoothly.{p}

"Whump☆"
The silhouette from before appeared right in front of me.
It happened so suddenly that I couldn't move from the spot.
Its face, upside down, stared fixedly at me.
It was a white-painted face, with eyes, nose and mouth like holes gouged out of it. It was eerie.
Suddenly the thing started laughing, and then just as suddenly it flew into a rage.
"Ptooey!"
And then that face spat right in my face.
"Ugh☆"{p}

With the bang of the window slamming shut, the thing vanished.
"..."
I wiped the spit off my face with my arm.
Even so, I felt awful...
That's it, I'll wash my face.
Then maybe I'll feel a little better.{p}

"I'll try opening the door one more time."
With that thought, I took hold of the doorknob.
Then I slowly turned the knob.

"★"
...There in front of me was the restroom I should have just left.
"Why★"
Then I hurriedly turned around.{p}

"Bang☆"
Then the door slammed shut.
"Damn, not again!"
I grabbed the knob to open the door, but it wouldn't open.
I was right back where I had been before.
"For now, I have to calm down..."{p}

I told him everything that had just happened.
"I see, so that's what happened..."
He was so fat it was hard to tell, but his eyes seemed to be gazing somewhere far away.
The restroom door was open.
The door that had been shut so tight now stood open as if it were nothing.
If I was going to escape, it was now.{p}

Then a gurgling sound came from the toilet.
"★"
Pathetically, my legs had given out under me.
"Hosoda!
This is bad!
...Hosoda★"
He had already gotten back up long ago.
Something about him was off.
"...I told you not to come out yet.
You're so impatient."
He started walking toward the toilet.
Then he stuck his face into the toilet and was mumbling something.
Whatever happens, I have to get out of here☆
My legs had given out, and I couldn't move the way I wanted.
Now Hosoda had plunged his hand into the toilet.
With a squelching, sucking sound, he seemed to pull out something black.{p}

"Your friend is here."
Saying that, he walked toward me.
"Time for introductions."
He thrust his right hand out at me.{p}

Grinning, the face peered into mine, and then all of a sudden it bit down on my nose☆
A searing pain shot through me.{p}

The face was tearing chunks out of my face and body.
On top of my legs having given out, my body wouldn't move, as if I were frozen in paralysis.
By now, the face seemed to have torn through the great artery in my throat.
Little by little, my consciousness was fading.
In my blurred vision, I saw pieces of my own flesh coming out of the torn-off part of its throat.{p}

Just what was Hosoda, anyway...?
At this point, none of that matters anymore...
"No, no.
You ate one again?
If you eat them, they can't become your friends, can they?"
His voice sounded far away.{p}

"Huh? You can feel it?
I see, so you really do have a stronger sixth sense than I do.
I can't feel anything myself, but there are some strange rumors about this place.
Come on, let's go inside."
Hosoda went into the restroom, practically shoving {f:me|me} in ahead of him.{p}

"I'm sorry to the rest of you, but please leave {a}{f:|} and me alone together.
I think our sixth senses will get stronger if it's just {a}{f:|} and me.
I feel like the two of us have similar auras.
I'm terribly sorry, but I'd appreciate your cooperation."
Everyone left the restroom with looks that said they had something to say.{p}

"...Over there."
{f:I|I} pointed at the far corner at the back of the restroom.
I really did get a bad feeling from it.
"Hmm.
It certainly does feel like there's something there."
Hosoda answered as if he didn't really believe me.
But {f:I|I} could feel it.
From the moment I stepped into this restroom, {f:I'd had the feeling|I'd been feeling} that someone was watching me.
{f:I|I} looked around the restroom.
The stalls, the urinals, the sinks...
It was when I looked at the corner to the left of the entrance door.{p}

...Nothing.
But I could have sworn I saw something black cross in front of me.
"What's wrong?
Was something there?"
{f:I|I} looked at the opposite corner.{p}

"Ah..."
{f:There it was again|It happened again}.
Something crossed my field of vision.
This time I {f:saw it clearly|could see it clearly}.
{f:That thing|It definitely} moved over to the corner beside the door from before{f:|}.{p}

I turned around at once.
…………
There was definitely something here.
{f:I|I} was suddenly terrified, and goosebumps broke out all over my body.{p}

"Hosoda.
Hasn't something been going back and forth in the corners of the restroom for a while now?"
Hosoda frantically looked all around.
"...I don't see anything in particular."
Honestly, does {f:this guy|this guy} really have a sixth sense?
He can't even see that.
Isn't he just convinced he has a sixth sense{f:|}?
"Hey, {a}{f:|}, is something there?
Hey, I can't see it, but you can, can't you?
Hey... hey..."
Hosoda leaned anxiously against {f:me|me} and gripped {f:my|my} arm tight.
{f:Jeez|Hey}, {f:what's with this guy|hold on a second}.
{f:He's giving me the creeps|I wish he'd stop}.{p}

"What★
What did you say!
So that rumor was true after all...
What do we do, {a}{f:|}?
I'm scared.
Hey, {a}{f:|}... hey, what do we do?"
Saying that, Hosoda {f:pressed his body up tight against me|flustered about helplessly}.
{f:Something was poking me around my hips|Hmm}, {f:and it was disgusting|what should I do}.
"Hosoda, please calm down.
It seems the black shadow runs away whenever I try to look at a corner.
If {f:we|we} both look at the two corners at once, it's bound to show up in one of them.
{f:I'll|I'll} watch this corner, so please watch the opposite one, Hosoda."{p}

"{f:Waaah|Kyaaah}☆"
A severed head was lying in the corner of the restroom.
"What's wrong?
Wait, waaah☆"
Hosoda {f:seemed|seemed} to have noticed it too.
The severed head of a young woman.
Her forehead was caved in as if she'd been struck with a blunt object, and her right eye was bulging out.
Hosoda was clinging to {f:me|me}, so I couldn't move.
{f:My|My} legs had given out, and I couldn't even run away.
Sweat poured out of my whole body, and my teeth were chattering uncontrollably.
My heart was beating faster and faster.
{f:I|I} was so terrified I didn't know what to do.
That's right, the seniors {f:should be|should be} just outside the restroom.
For now, I'll call for help.{p}

"……………"
M-my voice won't come out!
Am I paralyzed?
No, {f:that's not it|it isn't that}.
{f:I was so terrified my body just wouldn't obey me|My body just wouldn't listen to me, I was so scared}.
Just then, I heard a different voice inside my head.
If only it had been Hosoda's voice, how happy I would have been.
The owner of that voice {f:seemed|seemed} to be the severed head lying over there.{p}

Wriggling its half-shattered, twisted jaw, it {f:seemed|seemed} to be desperately trying to tell me something.
"Help me... help me... it hurts, my head hurts..."
"{f:Waaaaaaaaah|Nooooooooo}☆"
The scream I had tried so hard to let out and couldn't now burst out of me without my even realizing it.{p}

"Giggle giggle... giggle giggle..."
"...It hurts... help me... help me..."
"Heeey, over here, I'm right heeere!"
Male voices and female voices were coming from all around me.
The voices {f:spun|went spinning} around and around inside my head.
My heartbeat {f:grew|grew} even faster.
"{f:Stop|Stop}, {f:stop iiit|stop iiit}☆"
{f:I|I} looked up and screamed.{p}
